# Introduction
This essay examines the teaching of the present perfect to B1 learners. Learners often find its link to the present confusing (Swan, 2016). Thornbury (2006) notes that "aspect is about how the speaker views the event" (Thornbury, 2006).

## Analysis
The form combines have with a past participle (Parrott 2010: 212). Learners with Spanish L1 overuse it for finished time (Swan and Smith, 2001; Coe, 2001).

> A long quotation that a writer may exclude from the count.

| Problem | Example |
|---------|---------|
| finished time | I have seen him yesterday |

# Teaching approaches
Guided discovery helps learners notice the link to now (Scrivener, 2011).
